specs.rationale: The trend rule already registered as the DEMO forward benchmark (DEMO-XAUUSD-TREND-TSMOM-V1). Included unchanged so that the DEMO measurement and the historical measurement describe the same strategy.
specs.basis: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), Time Series Momentum — a broad, publicly documented phenomenon across liquid futures. It does NOT establish that this exact intraday XAUUSD rule is profitable.

specs.rationale: A volatility-normalized breakout: the channel is the realized high-low range, so the entry threshold widens and narrows with volatility instead of firing on a fixed price distance. Identical stop and time exit to A, so A and B differ in entry logic only.
specs.basis: Donchian channel / turtle breakout practice, publicly documented for decades. Chosen for the hypothesis, not for a result.

specs.rationale: Falsification control. Intraday gold does mean-revert at some horizons, which is exactly why this is here: a control that could plausibly pass is the only kind worth having. If BOTH a trend rule and its opposite survive the same gates, the gates are measuring something other than an edge.
specs.basis: Bollinger-band reversion, standard textbook construction. Included because microstructure makes it plausible, not because it is expected to win.

specs.rationale: Best long-history candidate from 2026-10-17 series (`ts9_lo`). Monthly trend sign on 9-month trailing return, long-only, sized to 10% annualised vol target, no leverage, no stop. Positive evaluation (+70,989 USD, Sharpe 0.837) on 1973-2026 data with assumed costs. Fails G3 (positive-year count), G5 (DSR < 0.95 at N=149; 0.929; 0.945 at N=237), G6 (<100 OOS turns), G7 (long-only cannot profit in DOWN regimes). Requires verified claim-eligible dataset + measured broker costs for promotion.
specs.basis: Time-series momentum / monthly trend following — publicly documented in Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012). The long-history evaluation is informational (assumed costs, one third-party source); it does NOT establish a validated edge without prerequisites.
